    Exclusion of generic bricks and generic grains over E-finite algebras #

    Section 7.1 of the manuscript (Lemmas 7.1 and 7.3, and the forward implications of Theorem 7.8 for (no-gen-brick), (no-gen-grain), and (ring-epi)):

    • TwoTerm.invertedOn_summand_of_divisionSemistable (Lemma 7.1): a (Λ, Δ)-bimodule semistable for the Δ-dimension Euler weight of a presilting complex P inverts every summand of P and therefore lies in the large τ-perpendicular category.
    • no_generic_right_brick_of_isEFinite (Lemma 7.3): induction on rank via perpendicular reduction rules out generic bricks over any E-finite algebra.
    • no_generic_right_grain_of_isEFinite and finite_simpleArtinian_ring_epimorphisms_of_isEFinite: taking the endomorphism socle rules out generic grains, and taking the unique simple module of an infinite-dimensional simple Artinian epimorphic target rules out such targets.

    U.InvertedOn M

    A bimodule semistable for the division-ring Euler weight of a presilting complex inverts the differential of every member of its additive closure in the homotopy category. In particular it belongs to the large perpendicular category of the basic representative.
